mapper.sql: booking_id, student_user_id, coach_user_id, vehicle_id, planned_start, planned_end, location, status, created_by, requested_at, assigned_by, assigned_at, actual_start, actual_end, valid_hours, result_note, cancelled_at

SELECT b.booking_id, b.student_user_id, su.real_name AS student_name, b.coach_user_id, cu.real_name AS coach_name, b.vehicle_id, v.plate_no, v.license_type, b.planned_start, b.planned_end, b.location, b.status, b.requested_at, b.actual_start, b.actual_end, b.valid_hours, b.result_note FROM training_booking b LEFT JOIN user_account su ON su.user_id = b.student_user_id LEFT JOIN user_account cu ON cu.user_id = b.coach_user_id LEFT JOIN training_vehicle v ON v.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM training_booking WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM training_booking WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND planned_start > #{fromTime} ORDER BY planned_start, booking_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_booking (planned_start, planned_end, location, status, created_by) VALUES (#{plannedStart}, #{plannedEnd}, #{location}, 'OPEN', #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE training_booking SET student_user_id = #{studentUserId}, status = 'PENDING', requested_at = NOW() WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND student_user_id IS NULL

UPDATE training_booking SET coach_user_id = #{coachUserId}, vehicle_id = #{vehicleId}, assigned_by = #{assignedBy}, assigned_at = NOW(), status = 'ASSIGNED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE training_booking SET actual_start = #{actualStart}, actual_end = #{actualEnd}, valid_hours = #{validHours}, result_note = #{resultNote}, status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'ASSIGNED'
UPDATE training_booking SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED')
UPDATE training_booking SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE student_user_id = #{studentUserId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED') AND planned_start > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valid_hours), 0) FROM training_booking WHERE student_user_id = #{studentUserId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
